summary: Compiles Calcite with a Gradle toolchain JDK (jdkBuildVersion, default 25) and --release 8, adds the foojay resolver, and installs JDK 25 in every CI job.

tests.evidence: Build-only change; verification is CI building and jandex parsing the bytecode, no test code needed.

user_docs.evidence: New jdkBuildVersion property and a new required JDK 25 were undocumented; howto.md still said use JDK 8 for release, develop/index.md asked for JDK 8u220; rubenada asked about the release instructions and commit b2d2b36e22 added the docs.

doc_comments.evidence: One comment on jdkBuildVersion in build.gradle.kts matches the code.

change_description.evidence: Contributor-facing build change; description is thorough and explains why, including the foojay 0.10.0 pin and ErrorProne JDK 11.

performance.evidence: No runtime code touched; build time not a concern raised.

security.evidence: foojay resolver can download a JDK from the network; CI disables auto-download, which covers the supply-chain angle.

backward_compat.evidence: Changes the supported build environment: every developer and the release manager now need JDK 25 installed (Gradle on Java 8 cannot download it), and the ErrorProne/Checker commands fail on JDK 25 as written; release steps had to change.

error_model.evidence: Missing-toolchain error comes from Gradle; the final docs quote it, nothing to design.

correctness.evidence: Removal of java.version task inputs is fine because the toolchain is a tracked input; --release 8 replaces source/target compatibility cleanly.

user_value.evidence: zabetak questioned whether the auto-download resolver is worth it and accepted it.

surprising_behavior.evidence: The build now silently downloads a JDK 25 when absent (zabetak: people may never realise which JDK they use); discussed and accepted with auto-download=false as the opt-out.

contradictions.evidence: Code now contradicts site/_docs/howto.md (release: use JDK 8, Error Prone requires Java 11) and site/develop/index.md (JDK 8u220 prerequisite, checker command without -PjdkBuildVersion=11); fixed in b2d2b36e22.

build_ci.evidence: Rewrites every job in .github/workflows/main.yml, adds a settings plugin and a toolchain for JavaCompile.

plan.why: One cohesive build change; docs drift and compatibility of the developer/release environment are all visible from the same Gradle and CI diff.
